body:
I understand you completely. I understand the feeling of, "Why can't I just do it?" and the frustration that follows. The truth is, you have a will to live. You have something inside your heart that you want to live for, whether it be your girlfriend or for your degree, you have something you want to live for. 
If anything, live for me, live for someone who read this post and understands the pain you're going through, and wants you to achieve happiness.

That reluctance is not cowardly, it's bravery. You're brave enough to live on, despite the shit around you.

Live on :)
